spec.rawSql:
SELECT org_unit_id, org_unit_name, report, flag_reason, patients_n
FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int)
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end, w.data_end,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT f.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'flag_score') AS flag_score, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'min_readings') AS min_readings
FROM report_fudging('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) f
WHERE f.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT band_low, band_high, readings_n, highlight
  FROM report_fudging_histogram('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int)
) h
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Readings in the last 3 months, counted by the top BP number in 5-point bands. Readings bunch under 140 when the 135–139 bar is much taller than the 140–144 bar. The dashed line marks 140, where high BP starts.
spec.title: Top BP number of each reading, last 3 months

spec.rawSql:
SELECT f.org_unit_id, f.org_unit_name, f.flag_reason, f.looks_fine_check, f.control_pct, fl.patients_n
FROM report_fudging('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) f
JOIN report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) fl ON fl.org_unit_id = f.org_unit_id AND fl.report = 'fudging'
WHERE f.flag AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT f.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'flag_score') AS flag_score, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'fudging' AND key = 'min_readings') AS min_readings,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_fudging('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) f
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = f.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

options.content: How this is worked out. Counts readings with a top BP number of 135–139 and of 140–144 in the last 3 months, and divides the first by the second. A high score is a reason to look at how BP is measured. The cuff, habit, training or rounding could each cause it. The score does not prove any of them.

spec.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1), 0) AS is_allowed
FROM grafana_schema.user u
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
  AND (
      u.is_admin = true
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
              WHERE t.name IN (
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
              )
          )
      )
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              t.name IN (
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'aggregated') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                  UNION
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'patients') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
              )
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
                  WHERE t.name IN (
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
                  )
                    AND hc.level <= (
                      SELECT level FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units
                      WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                      LIMIT 1
                    )
              )
          )
      )
  )
